summary: Tested playlist sort & filters feature on the live preview URL (https://treesh-phase5.preview.emergentagent.com/). Ran /app/memory/tests/plsort_live.py (adapted plsort.py to the public URL) — 35/35 checks passed, 0 failures, no page errors. Also validated responsive behavior at 390x844 (bottom sheet with backdrop) and 1920x1080 (anchored popover) by hand.
verified_behaviors: Custom order by default; drag handles visible only in Custom order
Sort menu has 7 options (custom/added/title/artist/played/release/duration)
Title A-Z sorts correctly; reverse toggles label to Z-A and flips order
Sort persists on playlist (plById(id).sort), survives leaving + returning
Most played sort shows per-row play count meta
Search filters live, keeps focus (pls-q), shows playlist-filter-count
resolveCtxList equals visible rows (play what you see)
Unplayed / Artist (chip shows artist name) / Genre / Hide explicit filters work and combine
No-match empty state with clear-filters action
Shuffle plays only filtered songs (state.base ids == visible ids)
Play turns global shuffle off and queue == visible list in order
Filters reset after leaving playlist; sort remembered
Playlist change tracked for account sync (treesh_playlists in sbKT keys)
Save this order -> songIds becomes current visible, sort back to custom, drag handles return
Back to custom order restores original drag order
Recently added: newly added song appears first in Recently added sort
Escape closes menu without leaving page; state.view stays 'playlist'
Duration sort measures lengths in background, unknowns pushed last
Drag reorder in Custom keeps non-visible songs intact
Phone (<640px): sort menu renders as bottom sheet (y=436 of 844 viewport, full width 374)
Desktop: sort menu renders as anchored popover (280x338 near toolbar button)
Toolbar has no overflow on 390px (scrollWidth 362 ≈ clientWidth 358)
